perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: The roughly $4.7 billion seven-year PAC-3 MSE propulsion award materially extends munitions-production visibility.

A materially different primary source adds completed production of the first 35 Viper Shield systems, with 233 systems on order across eight allied nations, broadening evidence from awards into delivered manufacturing output.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Completed Viper Shield production is realized industrial execution, while PAC-3 capacity expansion remains forward execution work.
Breadth across propulsion, electronic warfare, sensors and counter-UAS reduces dependence on a single program but increases simultaneous capacity and supply-chain demands.
